title: CaptureManifest
description:
What one bounded capture covered, written to `<artifact>.manifest.json`.

Event JSONL records only events. The manifest records how they were
collected, so offline correlation can tell "not observed" from "not
captured" and keep losses that the live command reported.

all_gpu_activity.description:
Every kernel, copy, and memset on the target was recorded, not only
the selected endpoints.

artifact.description: The artifact this manifest describes; a mismatch makes it stale.

capture_failed.description: A collector entered a failed state.

cuda_devices.description: The UUID behind each CUDA device ordinal in the events.

peer_copies.description: Peer-to-peer copies were recorded with other copies.

record_limit_reached.description: The configured record limit that stopped the capture, if any.

selectors.description: Endpoint selectors the collectors were armed for.

window.description:
`CLOCK_MONOTONIC` nanoseconds from the first collector armed to the
final collection.

CaptureWindow.description:
`CLOCK_MONOTONIC` interval the capture's coverage holds for: from the
collector's ARM acknowledgment until after its final read. Activity that
was already running at ARM may begin before `start_ns`.

CudaDevice.description:
One CUDA device as the target saw it. `device_id` is the process's CUDA
ordinal, which `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` renumbers; the UUID names the
physical GPU across processes and in `nvidia-smi`.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the artifact bytes.

ManifestVersion.description: Version of the capture manifest contract.
